protocol.question: With the target procedure fixed, how does collected current-state support compare with exhaustive coverage?

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.sampling: uniform distinct local support positions mapped to global rows
optimizer.target_update_timing: after every optimizer step in both arms

gates.scope: each seed, final greedy; fresh above pooled random

collection.support: sorted unique pre-action current-state global row IDs; visitation frequency is not sampling weight
collection.successor_access: full training bank for detached queries; outside-support successors never enter current-state support

resource_limits.check_cadence: each collection step, each optimizer update, each evaluation layout, phase boundaries and after aggregation; sampled stop guard

limitations: Both arms receive privileged all-action transitions and full-bank detached successor queries; this is not trajectory-only online RL.
Collected current states are sampled uniformly over unique support, not weighted by visitation frequency.
The three initializations share one collection bank; these are not independent collection replications.
A support effect does not isolate online exploration, replay freshness or visitation weighting.

coverage.goal_near_definition: shortest-path distance at most 2 moves, all remaining clocks

successor_queries.denominator: all four nonterminal transitions from unique visited current states, before training

paired_differences.scope: final greedy, matched seed and layout
